sentences.text: The F.I.R. is lodged by the victim herself.
She was 33  years of age.
She was earlier married to her first husband.
She had  a daughter from that marriage.
She was divorced afterwards.

She  got married second time to her second husband in the year 2020.
 Her second husband was already married and he used to visit the  informant's house some times.
It is alleged that, on 11.01.2024 in  the midnight the applicant called her many times from his phone  and in the midnight entered her house and established forcible  physical relations with her.
At that time her daughter woke up.
The  informant shouted.
At that time, her husband returned home.
In  the meantime, the applicant ran away.
On this basis the F.I.R. is  lodged.
5. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that, it  was a consensual love affair.
The applicant had exchanged the  messages with the informant.
Learned counsel relied on the  screenshots of those messages.
He also submitted that the  applicant has received CCTV footage of the police station which he  had obtained through the Right to Information Act.

7. Considering these submissions, it is necessary for the  investigating agency to look into these aspects as submitted by
the  learned counsel for the Applicant

. Therefore, for the time being,
 the applicant can be protected by ad-interim order.
The  investigating agency will have to respond to these submissions.
8. Hence, the following order.

ORDER i) In the event of his arrest in connection with C.R.No.12 of 2024 registered at Shahapur Police Station, Thane Rural, till the next date, the Applicant is directed to be released on bail on his executing P. R. bond in the sum of Rs.30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand Only) with one or two sureties in the like amount.
ii) This order shall operate till 19/03/2024.
iii) The Applicant shall attend the concerned Police 4 of 4 21-aba-450-24 Station from 04/03/2024 to 06/03/2024 between 1.00p.m. to 5.00p.m. and thereafter as and when called and shall cooperate with the investigation.
iv) Stand over to 19/03/2024.

(SARANG V. KOTWAL, J.)
